search.description: Full-text search term to match across all milestone fields.

timeline.description: If true, renders a complete ASCII timeline grouped by era.

markdown.description: If true, outputs a markdown-formatted table with era and protagonist columns.

range.description: Year range filter in YYYY-YYYY format (e.g., '2012-2026').

era.description: Era filter. Valid: genesis, symbolic, winters, renaissance, deep_learning, foundation, singularity.

dot.description: If true, exports a Graphviz DOT directed graph.

stats.description: If true, shows distribution statistics across eras.

json.description: If true, outputs in JSON format.

thermodynamic_focus.description: If true, enforces O(1) exergy explanation.
